transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, October 7. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Flydubai cockpit attack left Capt Smit Machchhar with 'depressed skull fracture'. Captain Smit Machchhar faced serious injuries from his co-pilot during the flight's crisis situation. The co-pilot attacked him with an axe, resulting in a skull fracture that required emergency surgery. Doctors monitored his recovery closely and assisted him for further treatment in the UAE. The Indian embassy is providing support to Captain Machchhar and his family during this challenging time. 13 Navy personnel under scanner in Pakistan-linked espionage probe. A significant counter-intelligence operation named 'Operation Firewall-2026' is underway across multiple states in India. Eighteen individuals are being investigated for their suspected connections to an espionage network linked to Pakistan. Among the suspects, 13 are reported Navy personnel, and electronic devices have been seized during searches. Two individuals have already been arrested for allegedly leaking sensitive information related to the Indian Navy. All 10 Rajya Sabha candidates from UP set to get elected unopposed. In the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections, all 10 candidates from BJP and Samajwadi Party are set to be elected unopposed. Samajwadi Party decided against fielding a third candidate, eliminating the possibility of a contest. The BJP is positioned to secure all eight available seats due to its majority in the Assembly. The results will be formally declared after the nomination scrutiny concludes on October 9. Gujarat: Married woman, lover forced into public sex as 'punishment'. A shocking incident occurred in Surendranagar where a couple was subjected to horrific punishment by the woman's husband. After the couple was located, police arrested nine individuals involved in the brutal acts. The couple was reportedly filmed during the ordeal, which was shared on social media. Authorities were alerted by local community leaders who facilitated the police intervention. SpaceX overpumped 128M gallons of groundwater; now Texas city has to pay $175,000. McGregor has agreed to pay $175,000 in penalties for groundwater overuse linked to SpaceX's activities. The city will make a one-time payment and subsequent quarterly payments over 25 years. Residents have expressed concerns over the arrangement, as SpaceX primarily drove the overpumping issue. City officials are exploring alternative water sources to address future needs. From Gujarat CM to India's PM: Modi's 25 years in office. Narendra Modi's journey began with his role as Gujarat Chief Minister, addressing state issues and implementing reforms. His tenure included launching significant initiatives like the Jan Dhan Yojana and Swachh Bharat Mission, aimed at improving welfare. The BJP's political maneuvers led to Modi becoming Prime Minister in 2014, marking a significant shift in governance. Man deposits rupees 85.3 lakh given to him as cash gifts, gets notice; ITAT gives relief. In one such case in Chennai, a man received cash gifts of rupees 85.03 lakh from his relatives. The Income Tax Department began making enquiries into the source of the rupees 85.03 lakh deposited by the man. The department also sent tax notices to the relatives who had given him the cash. The man eventually won relief in ITAT Chennai. CBI raids CM Bhagwant Mann's camp office, his OSD's home in graft probe. CBI conducted raids on multiple locations including the camp office of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections. Brent crosses $101 as Saudi attacks, US storm add to oil supply concerns. Rising oil prices, now exceeding 1 percent , raise alarms over potential storm disruptions affecting U.S. oil production and refineries. With Brent crude passing $101 per barrel and WTI crude hitting $90.38, concerns are amplified by supply issues from Saudi Arabia and mixed signals on U.S. inventories. Teen couple commit suicide on Instagram live in Dahod forest; family among viewers. A man named Rajesh Ninama and a 16-year-old girl ended their lives in Dahod district. They livestreamed the act on Instagram, leaving viewers horrified and their families devastated. Rajesh had approached his parents for permission to marry the girl, but they refused due to clan differences. Following this rejection, the couple decided to take their own lives in a forested area. 40M-year-old glass sponge reefs found alive off B.C. after thought extinct. In 1987, Canadian scientists discovered ancient glass sponge reefs alive in British Columbia's Hecate Strait, overturning the belief that these reef-building animals had vanished 40 million years ago. More than 9,000 years old, the reefs survive today in Hecate Strait, Queen Charlotte Sound and Howe Sound, creating a rare underwater ecosystem often called the "Sea of Glass."
